notes.title: Update 1.1
notes.content:
Flies bots are destroyed if the real flies more than 2 
People bots are destroyed in a minute
A MOP to clean only the sink and toilet. Bucket removed
People don't stumble on the small things 
Appeared in sight in the form of a point
The chairs are not taken through the table 
Blood does not appear in remote places 
A MOP now dirty from blood
Sound lifting and throwing objects
The objects do not pass through the tables and walls
